name: 10b-convert-text-completion
description:
convertTextCompletionPrompt (prompt-converters.js:961-977). Three messages cover all three render rules: an unnamed system turn renders as 'System: ' (:968-969), a NAMED system turn (example_assistant here) renders as 'name: ' (:970-971), and every other role renders as 'role: ' (:972-973). The joiner is a single '
' -- not the '

' the merge functions use -- and the whole thing is terminated with '
assistant:' (:976), which is why the tail looks like a dangling turn. `name` is NOT deleted here; the reference only reads it, so a port that mutates the messages would diverge in `mutated`.
